I can’t see your ticket data. If you just need a single ballpark to drop into a deck, use ~5% (plausible range: 2–10% depending on product and rollout).

Quick way to get an exact value: count tickets from last quarter that mention SSO (or have an SSO tag) and divide by total tickets. Example SQL-ish query:
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' AND (subject ILIKE '%sso%' OR body ILIKE '%single sign-on%' OR tags @> '{sso}')) AS sso_count,
       COUNT(*) AS total_count
FROM tickets;
sso_count/total_count

If you want, tell me your total ticket count and I can compute the percent for you from that.
